Though they happen somewhat frequently, plumbing leaks do not have to be a major cause of concern. Water damage can be avoided as long as the leak is found and fixed quickly. Ignored leaks can cause problems, including mildew and foul smells as well as mold development. Sometimes extreme structural damage can even be a result, which can lead to high repair bills.

You should be on lookout for the key indicators of a leak. Should your house continuously smell moldy or musty or damp, a leak could be the reason.
